title: Resolve missing known-new project capacity authority

conditions.description: Identify and pin an authoritative producer/contract for known-new project creation and complete writer coverage, project total/role policy, inventory/generation, reservation and uncertain-effect occupancy, and trustworthy observation time, all composable in the same project Git CAS. Or reconcile the task's scope with a HOLD-only result. Accepted abef95dc's initializer is test-only; fixture records cannot prove production baseline or writer coverage. Existing LedgerHeader only supplies project/ledger/epoch and per-agent MaxWorkingPerAgent; scripts/jarvis-phase2-snapshot-adapter.mjs intentionally marks project capacity incomplete. Please specify the owner/source and exact contract; no extra approval/signature system.
conditions.evidence: Reconcile W21 task to the explicit HOLD-only outcome for missing authority, as permitted by this condition and its existing spec. Do not fabricate positive known-new evidence: fixture initialization is not production proof. LedgerStore.fs 79-93 and 1335-1358 supply identity and per-agent setting, not project total/role policy or writer coverage. Separate policy producer task automation-project-capacity-policy-producer-20261124 is assigned Ready to Worker 14, attempt c095d4f0324a4c0bbd5b2307a0311058, spec fe57b63222045f4408885cde8ccfe5961cf768f0; it is default-off, new-files-only and requires same-snapshot CAS, identity binding and tests. This is only a policy input, not evidence for inventory baseline, writer coverage, freshness, reservation, uncertain effects, or positive admission. W21 should finish and submit the bounded HOLD contract and exact missing producers for independent review; downstream W23/W19 remain gated until appropriate real evidence exists.
